Let's start by expanding each term of the right-hand side.
By @thm-bias-exprs, the squared bias is:

$$
\begin{aligned}
\sqf{\bias{\hth}}
&= \sqf{\E{\hth} - \th}
&& \text{(bias equals expectation minus truth)}\\
&= \sqf{\E{\hth}} - 2\E{\hth}\th + \th^2
&& \text{(expand the binomial square)}
\end{aligned}
$$

The variance is
([simplified expression for variance](https://morrison-lab.github.io/rme/chapters/probability.html#thm-variance)):

$$\var{\hth} = \E{\hth^2} - \sqf{\E{\hth}}$$

Now, add them together and simplify:

$$
\begin{aligned}
\sqf{\bias{\hth}} + \var{\hth}
&= \sqf{\E{\hth}} - 2\E{\hth}\th + \th^2 + \E{\hth^2} - \sqf{\E{\hth}}
&& \text{(substitute both expansions)}\\
&= \E{\hth^2} - 2\E{\hth}\th + \th^2
&& \text{(cancel $\sqf{\E{\hth}}$)}
\end{aligned}
$$

Now let's expand the left-hand side to reach the same expression:

$$
\begin{aligned}
\mselr{\hth}
&\eqdef \E{\sqf{\erf{\hth}}}
&& \text{(definition of MSE)}\\
&= \E{(\hth - \th)^2}
&& \text{(definition of estimation error)}\\
&= \E{\hth^2 - 2\hth\th + \th^2}
&& \text{(expand the binomial square)}\\
&= \E{\hth^2} - \E{2\hth\th} + \E{\th^2}
&& \text{(linearity of expectation)}\\
&= \E{\hth^2} - 2\E{\hth}\th + \th^2
&& \text{($\th$ is a constant)}
\end{aligned}
$$

$\mselr{\hth}$ and $\sqf{\bias{\hth}} + \var{\hth}$
both equal $\E{\hth^2} - 2\E{\hth}\th + \th^2$.
Equality is transitive,
so $\mselr{\hth}$ and $\sqf{\bias{\hth}} + \var{\hth}$
are equal to each other:

$$\mselr{\hth} = \sqf{\bias{\hth}} + \var{\hth}$$
